Cc: salesops@sparksource.io
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Demo request from pricing page (Budget intent)

Hi Karthik,

I filled out the demo request on your pricing page this morning. We have a roughly $50k/yr budget and are evaluating inference platforms for production LLMs. Would like a short walkthrough focused on throughput, latency, and pricing profiles for reserved capacity.

Ideal participants on our side: me and Alyssa (technical PM). We are based in PST and prefer afternoons next week.

Attached our short intro deck.

Thanks,
Jordan

Head of ML Platforms
SparkSource

Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from pricing page (Budget intent)

Hi Jordan — thanks for reaching out and for the deck. I’m Karthik on the Growth/SDR team at Redwood. Happy to run a focused session on throughput, latency targets, and committed pricing (Dedicated).

Quick options for a 30‑minute call next week (PST):
- Tue 12/01 2:00–2:30 PM
- Wed 12/02 3:00–3:30 PM
- Thu 12/03 11:00–11:30 AM

If none of those work, here’s my scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30m — feel free to pick a time and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Goals I’ll cover: short architecture map, perf numbers (p99/p50), example pricing with Dedicated vs hosted, and recommended next steps for a pilot. If Alyssa can join, great — please loop her in.

I’ve attached a one-page pricing snapshot so you have context for the call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
